description: Step 1 functional scope: make disk list_documents honor the agent tool path contract and return successful filtered pages when configured volume roots do not exist. Owners: DiskBridge maps provider path input; Storage owns filesystem root enumeration. Tests first: DiskBridge maps / and nested disk paths while preserving filters.parent; Storage omits ENOENT roots, keeps accessible existing roots, and preserves ACL filtering. Branches: root path, nested path, filters precedence, all-missing roots, mixed roots, unauthorized entries, non-ENOENT errors. Mocking: DiskBridge router stub only; Storage uses temporary filesystem. Docs: no docs update expected because this restores documented behavior. Validation: focused tests, mix format, mix q.
